mentions.name: Emacs Latin study workflow essay
mentions.description: A written essay demonstrating how the author uses GNU Emacs together with gptel, Gemini, local models, yt-dlp, and patreon-dl to study Latin, covering converting Internet Archive textbook scans into Org mode documents, XML-database dictionary lookups, an audio transcription pipeline with forced alignment and linguistic analysis, and automatic flash card creation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm writing an essay about how I use an ancient text editor, GNU Emacs, along with gptel, Gemini, some local models, yt-dlp, and patreon-dl to help me me study an ancient language, Latin.
